title: Tableau Failures by Workbook
dataSources: Tableau logs (`tableau:httpd`, `tableau:vizportal`, `tableau:backgrounder`), REST API, and `workgroup` repository tables via DB Connect.
app: Tableau Server logs via Universal Forwarder; Tableau Server REST API and TSM metrics via HEC; `workgroup` repository via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=tableau:httpd status>=500
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by workbook
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Tableau failures grouped by workbook so operators immediately see which specific workbooks are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Tableau is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Tableau failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical workbooks.
visualization: Table of workbook by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Tableau are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
